h:
You know the feeling when someone dismisses what you’re holding.

Not argues against it. Dismisses it. “That’s not even in the Bible.” The kind of sentence that ends conversations before they start.

And you stood there holding 1 Enoch with no response, because the person across from you was technically correct. It is not in their Bible. It is not in your Bible. It is not in the sixty-six-book Protestant canon or the seventy-three-book Catholic canon.

You lost the argument you never got to have.

The question you wanted to ask — why not? — became irrelevant the moment they established that the text was outside the authorized list. Canon functions like jurisdiction. If it is not in the list, it does not count. And if it does not count, nothing it says matters, no matter how specific, no matter how verified, no matter how early.

The conversation ended. You were holding a document that quoted itself into the New Testament and still did not qualify.

That exact feeling, the trap, the dismissal, the inability to respond, Enoch predicted you would experience. And he addressed the text to you anyway. Before the trap was built. Before the list was shortened. Before the conversation you just lost ever happened.

He wrote your name on the outside.

Open 1 Enoch to chapter 104. The last chapter before the conclusion. The summary. The final instructions.

1 Enoch 104:10:

“And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practice great deceits, and write books concerning their words.”

Enoch predicted that religious authorities would alter texts. He predicted they would write justifications for the alterations. And he wrote this prediction inside a text that would itself be altered, removed from the canon while the authorities wrote books explaining why the removal was necessary.

The verse predicted the removal of the verse.

Enoch told you what would happen to Enoch.

And then, two verses later, he told you what to do about it.

1 Enoch 104:12-13:

“And now I know another mystery, that books will be given to the righteous and the wise to become a cause of joy and uprightness and much wisdom. And to them shall the books be given, and they shall believe in them and rejoice over them, and then shall all the righteous who have learnt therefrom all the paths of uprightness be recompensed.”

Books given to the righteous. Not to councils. Not to institutions. To individuals who would receive them, believe them, learn from them.

The chain of custody runs through character, not through authority.

Now go to the beginning. The opening dedication. The address on the envelope.

1 Enoch 1:1-3:

“The words of the blessing of Enoch, wherewith he blessed the elect and righteous, who will be living in the day of tribulation, when all the wicked and godless are to be removed. And he took up his parable and said, Enoch a righteous man, whose eyes were opened by God, saw the vision of the Holy One in the heavens, which the angels showed me, and from them I heard everything, and from them I understood as I saw, but not for this generation, but for a remote one which is for to come.”

Read that last line again.

Enoch opens the record by telling the people standing in front of him, his sons, his contemporaries, the ones who could ask him questions over a fire, that this text is not for them.

He saw the generation that would need it. A remote generation. A specific people living in a specific season under specific conditions. He addressed the text to them directly, over the heads of everyone in between.

The people who would dismiss the text for not being in their Bible? Enoch saw them. The institutions that would remove it while writing books justifying the removal? He predicted them. The arguments you would lose because the text was not in the authorized list? He anticipated them.

“Write books concerning their words” to justify the alteration. Not just remove the text, explain why the removal was necessary. Build arguments. Train audiences. Establish that the boundary is divinely drawn, that what remains is what God preserved, that the removed texts were never Scripture to begin with.

The arguments exist now. In seminaries. In commentaries. In online platforms where Christian teachers build followings by telling people what not to read. Pseudepigraphy means forgery. Citation does not equal canonization. Your Bible has its number of books and none are missing, which is not proof, just an assertion dressed as conclusion.

The people making these arguments are not lying. They inherited a boundary and called standing inside it faithfulness. They teach what they were taught. They defend what they received. But the text they are dismissing predicted they would dismiss it, explained why they would dismiss it, and addressed itself to the generation that would receive it after the dismissal was complete.

The removal was part of the delivery system.

He wrote to you anyway. To the remote generation. The one holding the text after the long underground transit is complete.

Go to chapter 8. The curriculum. The technology transfer record.

1 Enoch 8:1-3:

“And Azazel taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures. And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways. Semjaza taught enchantments, and root-cuttings, Armaros the resolving of enchantments, Baraqijal taught astrology, Kokabel the constellations, Ezeqeel the knowledge of the clouds, Araqiel the signs of the earth, Shamsiel the signs of the sun, and Sariel the course of the moon.”

Stop there and look at what you are reading.

This is not a vague account of angelic rebellion. This is a detailed record of technology transfer. Specific angels. Specific curriculum. Specific skills taught to a human population that was not ready to metabolize them.

Azazel taught weapons manufacturing. Metallurgy. Cosmetics. Ornamentation. The capacity to kill efficiently and look good doing it. Semjaza taught manipulation, root-cuttings, the early pharmaceutical knowledge that would become sorcery. Baraqijal taught divination systems. How to read patterns and predict outcomes.

These are not random skills. This is the foundation curriculum of every rising empire. Military technology. Aesthetic control. Predictive systems. Pharmaceutical leverage.

The Watchers did not just sin. They taught. They transferred knowledge before humanity had the wisdom to resist what the knowledge would produce. They accelerated development past the point of constraint.

Technology without wisdom. Power without accountability. Enhancement without cost analysis.

That is the original violation Enoch documents.

Now look at the verse that follows.

1 Enoch 8:4:

“And the women became pregnant, and they bare great giants.”

The technology transfer produced hybrids. Biological category violation followed pedagogical category violation.

The Watchers taught what should not have been taught. The students produced what should not have been born. The earth filled with violence and corruption. And the flood came.

Specific names. Specific curriculum. Specific outcome. Specific judgment.

The question is not why God allowed the removal. The question is what the removal required.

A text this specific about the violations that institutional power depends on could not remain in general circulation. The Western canon contracted across multiple councils. At each contraction, Enoch was outside the boundary.

But the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church never received the memo. Their canon preserved eighty-one books, Enoch among them, continuous, uninterrupted, without revision. The Coptic witness held it. The Dead Sea Scrolls contained more complete copies of 1 Enoch than nearly any other text recovered from Qumran.

The removal was not universal. It was Western. Which means the chain of custody Enoch described kept running while the councils met.

Now look at what is happening around you.

Silicon Valley talks about acceleration. Disruption. Distributing technology before society is ready to metabolize it. Azazel taught metallurgy before humanity understood what weapons would cost them. Algorithmic prediction engines now tell you what you will buy, who you will date, what you will believe before you know it yourself,

Baraqijal’s curriculum, venture-capital funded. Transhumanists advocate openly for human-machine merger, genetic modification, consciousness uploading. Enoch called the earlier version of this hybrid creation.

Same violation. Different season. Different costume.

The text kept moving through all of it. Through Ethiopia. Through Qumran. Through the Desert Fathers who cited it freely before the councils met. Through Jude, who quoted it directly in the New Testament as authoritative prophecy.

Books given to the righteous and wise. Not to institutions. To individuals who would receive them, believe them, learn from them the paths of uprightness.

You were told the text does not count because it is not in your Bible. The text predicted you would be told that.

Go back to chapter 8. Read what Azazel taught, the metallurgy, the cosmetics, the divination, the enchantments. Then look at your phone. Your feed. The algorithm that predicts you. The enhancement technology that promises to make you more than human.

See where Azazel’s students are teaching now.

Then read chapter 91.

1 Enoch 91:7:

“And after that, in the tenth week in the seventh part, there shall be the great eternal judgment, in which He will execute vengeance amongst the angels. And the first heaven shall depart and pass away, and a new heaven shall appear, and all the powers of the heavens shall give sevenfold light.”

The technology transfer operation does not run forever.

Enoch saw what ends it.

You lost the argument because the text was not in the authorized list.

Enoch predicted you would lose that argument. He wrote to you anyway.

The chain of custody did not break. It just moved underground. Through Ethiopia. Through the caves at Qumran. Through the Desert Fathers. Through Jude into the New Testament itself.

Books given to the righteous and wise.

Not to councils. To you.

The envelope has your name on it. Open it.
